platforms.question: Which platforms are supported?
platforms.answer: Facebook Pages, Instagram professional accounts, YouTube channels and TikTok. You can publish posts, reels, stories, videos, shorts, albums and carousels, depending on what each platform allows.

security.question: How is our clients’ data kept safe?
security.answer: Each workspace’s data is stored separately from every other workspace. Access tokens for connected social accounts are encrypted at rest and never shown in the browser.

roles.question: Can I control what each team member can do?
roles.answer: Yes. Create custom roles with exactly the permissions you need — for example, writers who can draft posts but not publish them.

approvals.question: Can clients approve posts before they go live?
approvals.answer: Yes. Send posts for review, collect feedback and keep a full history of every review decision.

pricing.question: How much does it cost?
pricing.answer: It’s free during early access, with every feature included. When paid plans for larger teams launch, existing workspaces will get notice before anything changes.

language.question: Is Arabic supported?
language.answer: Yes. The whole app is available in English and Arabic, with a full right-to-left layout.
